name: Checklist Todo
author: abobreshov
description: A tiny todo list in the Omarchy bar with a focus, doing/done states, plan steps and notes, and your North Star one click away; keeps its own JSON file or reads and writes through todocli.

barWidget.description: A tiny todo list in the bar. Add items with a name and description, tick them done, focus one and start a pomodoro for it.

schema.label: Store: json (the plugin's own file) or cli (todocli)
todocli command name or absolute path
IPC target of the pomodoro plugin
Pill label length on horizontal bars (0 = icon only)
